cv.name: Olivia Marsh
cv.headline: Procurement Officer | Public sector and facilities procurement
cv.summary: Procurement officer with four years in social housing and facilities services. I run tenders under public procurement rules, manage supplier contracts and enjoy getting the details of a specification right.

experience.title: Procurement Officer
bullets: Run tenders for cleaning, security and maintenance services up to £2M
Manage supplier performance reviews and contract KPIs
Created a contract register that flags renewals six months ahead
Support the move to a new e-sourcing tool (Proactis)

experience.title: Procurement Assistant
bullets: Prepared tender documents and evaluation sheets under the Public Contracts Regulations 2015
Handled purchase orders and supplier onboarding

certifications: CIPS Level 4 Diploma in Procurement and Supply, 2025
